Body.Content:
Insider risk management will be introducing the ability to classify alerts as True positive, Benign (operational), and False positive. This will be available on all alerts where authorized analysts with the appropriate permissions can choose from a list of predefined classification reasons. Alert classification will help tenants to better classify risk within alerts to support reporting and tuning needs. This will replace existing dismissal reasons.

GA date: January CY2027

Preview date: November CY2026
